title: Finish Level of the Design Studio Selections File in Calloway Limited Home Warranty Settlements
content:
A finish-item cash settlement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty carries a finish-level multiplier, applied to the program's cash-in-lieu maximum in the scheduled finish settlement.

**Rule.** The finish-level multiplier reads the Design Studio Selections file of the home's Home Purchase Agreement, whose finish upgrades are the option lines added in the flooring, cabinetry and countertops categories less the option lines removed in those categories (option lines in any other category are not finish upgrades):

- a file on Studio Designer, Studio Signature or Studio Atelier with finish upgrades of USD 12000 or more takes 1.30;
- a file on one of those three packages with finish upgrades of at least USD 5000 but under USD 12000 takes 1.15;
- a file on Studio Essentials, Studio Classic or Studio Select with finish upgrades of USD 5000 or more takes 1.10;
- any other file takes 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

## Truth table

| Package of the file | Finish upgrades under USD 5000 | USD 5000 or more, under USD 12000 | USD 12000 or more |
|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Designer, Studio Signature, Studio Atelier | 1.00 | 1.15 | 1.30 |
| Studio Essentials, Studio Classic, Studio Select | 1.00 | 1.10 | 1.10 |

## Worked finish upgrades (hypothetical file on Studio Signature)

| Option line on the file's ledger | Category | Counted |
|---|---|---|
| Added, USD 8000 | flooring | adds 8000 |
| Added, USD 6000 | cabinetry | adds 6000 |
| Removed, USD 1500 | countertops | takes away 1500 |
| Added, USD 3000 | lighting | not a finish upgrade |

Finish upgrades: 8000 and 6000, less 1500, which is USD 12500; at USD 12000 or more on an upper package the multiplier is 1.30. Had the countertop removal been USD 2500, the upgrades would be USD 11500 and the multiplier 1.15.
